About Me

My name is MacKenzie Wickel, founder of Triple Crown Health, where my mission is to help individuals, families, and small businesses navigate the health insurance process with clarity, confidence, and personalized support. I believe choosing the right coverage shouldn't be overwhelming, and I'm committed to making the experience as simple, transparent, and stress-free as possible.

I hold a degree from the University of Denver, and I've spent more than five years in the health insurance industry, helping clients understand their options and find coverage that aligns with their healthcare needs, lifestyle, and budget. Every client is unique, which is why I take the time to educate, answer questions, and provide tailored recommendations rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.

As an independent broker, I have access to a variety of trusted insurance carriers, allowing me to compare plans and help clients make informed decisions based on what works best for them—not a single company. Whether you're self-employed, between jobs, aging off a parent's plan, looking for family coverage, or exploring options for your business, I'm here to guide you every step of the way.

At Triple Crown Health, building long-term relationships is just as important as finding the right policy. My goal is to be a trusted resource my clients can rely on not only during enrollment, but throughout the life of their coverage. When you work with me, you can expect honest advice, responsive communication, and a genuine commitment to helping you protect what matters most.
